	We have recently identified that works carried out to a neighbouring property have had a material impact on the integrity of our property.&nbsp; We have agreed a program of works to our basement area together with other minor works at the property to address the relevant issues raised by the Food Standards Team.&nbsp; We have held a 5 star food standards rating for a very long time and expect to be back operating at that level in the very near future.</p>
